questions.text: What industry do you work in?
How many years of experience do you have?
Have you ever applied to a job that you later suspected was never actually open or had no real intent to hire?
At what stage did you realize the job was likely a 'ghost job'?
Did you incur any of the following out-of-pocket costs while pursuing a role you now suspect was a "ghost job"? (Select all that apply)
questions.note: The export holds one answer per respondent for this question.

questions.text: Which of the following 'red flags' made you realize the role wasn't real? (Select all that apply)
options: The listing has been active for 3+ months.
The job was reposted immediately after I was rejected;
The recruiter  mentioned they aren't "actually" hiring yet;
The job description was clearly AI-generated/nonsensical.
The company website shows a hiring freeze
The recruiter admitted they are just "building a pipeline"
questions.note: The export holds one answer per respondent for this question.

questions.text: In the past 6 months, approximately how many of your total job applications do you believe went to ghost or fake listings?
As a result of encountering ghost jobs, have you changed your job search behavior in any of the following ways? (Select all that apply)
options: I only apply if I know someone at the company
I reach out directly to hiring managers
I check Glassdoor or Reddit before applying
I have permanently boycotted the company's products/services
questions.note: The export holds one answer per respondent for this question.
